transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this pre-show huddle started. We've got the one-night orchestral film-score performance tonight at 7:30 PM in the Grand Hall, and our current production sheet lists 18 musicians, two suspended scenic frames, and a rehearsal from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM. I need the music, rigging, and artist leads to report any changes now so I can record approved revisions. Who wants to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a change on the music side. This morning I confirmed that the signed musicians agreement for this repertoire requires exactly 24 players, not 18, and a 20-minute break from 8:15 PM to 8:35 PM. I haven't entered the amendment in the production sheet yet, but we need to update it.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rigging issue. My certified rigging inspection found that the overhead points may carry no more than 450 kg in total, but the two planned scenic frames and their rigging hardware would weigh 510 kg. That's 60 kg over the certified limit. One frame weighing 240 kg would be within the limit, but two frames would not be safe. I have not yet filed the revised load plan, so the production sheet still shows two suspended scenic frames. We need to either drop to one frame or find another solution before I can certify this rigging as safe.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a change on the artist side. I confirmed with the conductor's agent that the conductor and soloist are available for only a 90-minute rehearsal from 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM on performance day. This availability has not yet been added to the call sheet, and it conflicts with the current production sheet's rehearsal time of 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
transcript.speaker: A4
